### Notes

- EXPLICITLY EXCLUDES LOCF records (DTYPE = ''): MMRM uses observed data under MAR and must not be fed carried-forward values. ANL02FL is the observed-cases record flag.
- Critic finding R-2 recommends this as the more defensible headline analysis than T-14-3.01, because it uses every observed visit rather than depending on LOCF for ~11 of ~13 analysis values.
- AT N=17 THE UNSTRUCTURED COVARIANCE WILL ALMOST CERTAINLY FAIL TO CONVERGE. Fallback ladder, applied in order and recorded in the ARD: (1) unstructured, (2) Toeplitz, (3) compound symmetry, (4) if all fail, emit the descriptive companion only with an explicit non-convergence footnote. Do not silently drop the table.
- N-GATE CAVEAT: this study has 17 randomized subjects (Placebo 5 / Low 5 / High 7). All inferential statistics are illustrative and must not be interpreted.
- Model actually fitted: `CHG ~ TRTP + AVISIT + BASE`, with compound symmetry covariance and Kenward-Roger degrees of freedom.
- Fallback ladder: the analysis spec specifies an unstructured covariance with a treatment-by-visit interaction. It did not survive at this sample size; the ladder descended to **compound symmetry, ADDITIVE (no treatment-by-visit interaction)**, which is what is reported above. A rung is rejected either for failing to converge OR for converging to a numerically degenerate fit — LS-mean standard errors orders of magnitude larger than the response SD, i.e. unidentified parameters.
- **WARNING — no treatment-by-visit interaction.** The mean model reduced to an additive form, so the treatment effect is constrained to be constant across visits and the per-visit contrasts below are identical by construction. They are NOT evidence of a stable effect over time; they are the same number repeated. Do not read them as per-visit estimates.
- Observed cases only — LOCF records are excluded (`DTYPE = ''`), as MMRM operates under MAR.
- All values computed from ADaM via the persisted ARD (`ard.csv`); no value is hand-entered.
- Rounding: SAS convention (half away from zero), applied at display time only.

> **N-GATE WARNING.** This study randomized 17 subjects (Placebo 5 / Zanomaline Low 5 / Zanomaline High 7). Every inferential statistic in this display is **illustrative only** and must not be interpreted as evidence of effect or of absence of effect.
